module: GE extension `core_vehicle_mirror`: adjustment of a vehicle's mirror angles. Reads the mirror list from vdata.mirrors, applies an angle offset (offsetNormal) to the mirrors through veh:getMirror(id), stores the settings per model and per config in settings/mirrorOffsets.json, reapplies them each time the vehicle spawns, handles mouse dragging (vehicleEvent) and moves the driver camera to a mirror (focusOnMirror). Also contains a small ImGui debug window.
usage:
local offsets = core_vehicle_mirror.getAnglesOffset()   -- [meshName] = {name, id, angleOffset = {x, z}, clampX, clampZ, position, icon, row, label}
core_vehicle_mirror.setAngleOffset('mirror_L', 5, -3, nil, true)   -- x, z in degrees, save
notes: Angles are in degrees (x: up/down, z: left/right), clamped by default to ±20° (MAXDEGREE) or by clampX/clampZ defined in the mirror's jbeam. They are saved by `veh.JBeam`, then by config name ('custom' if the config is a serialized table), then by mirror mesh name.
The targeted vehicle is that of core_vehicle_configTarget (or the vehicle passed as an argument).
BUG: M.onExtensionUnloaded and M.onClientEndMission are assigned to local variables that are never defined (they equal nil); these hooks therefore do not exist.
onVehicleSpawned tests `if #offset` on a table with text keys: #offset equals 0, which is truthy in Lua, so the test always passes; it does not depend on the content.
Note the name conflict with core_vehicleMirrors (separate file, in core/): core_vehicle_mirror handles mirror orientation, core_vehicleMirrors the (inactive) rendering of their reflections.

onClientEndMission.desc: Equals nil (undefined local variable, see notes).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Equals nil (undefined local variable, see notes).

getAnglesOffset.desc: Lists the vehicle's mirrors with their current angle offset (stored setting or 0) and their limits.

returns.desc: [meshName] = {name, id, angleOffset = {x, z}, clampX, clampZ, position (UiColumn), icon, row (UiRow), label}; {} if no mirrors

setAngleOffset.desc: Applies an angle offset to a mirror (offsetNormal = (0,1,0) rotated by x and z) and stores the setting for the model/config.

setDebug.desc: Opens or closes the "core_vehicle_mirror Debugger" ImGui window (X/Z sliders per mirror).

vehicleEvent.desc: Mouse event on a mirror in the world: 'onDown' starts a drag adjustment, 'onUp' ends it and saves. Any other value: error log.

focusOnMirror.desc: Switches to the driver camera and, if the mirror is outside the field of view, orients the camera (relativeYaw/relativePitch) toward it. Without a name, restores the orientation from before the focus.

mirror_name.desc: mirror mesh name; nil = return to the previous orientation

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook: loads the settings from settings/mirrorOffsets.json.

onSerialize.desc: Hook: saves the open state of the debug window.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook: restores the debug window and recomputes the screen ratio.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook: recomputes the mouse degrees/pixel ratio from the resolution (20° over the average of width+height).

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: a vehicle is destroyed (does nothing).

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook: a vehicle spawns; reapplies the stored settings of all its mirrors.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: applies the ongoing mouse drag and shows the debug window if open.
